question: Does unchanged H72 transfer from the confirmed 8K milestone to GLM-5.3-flash at 10K within cumulative model input plus output tokens?

hypotheses.mechanism: The terminal evidence-selection bottleneck persists when the native context grows from 8K to 10K.
hypotheses.prediction: Unchanged H72 gains at least 0.05 macro Span-F1 with non-degrading secondary metrics and non-increasing aggregate tokens.
hypotheses.falsifier: A causally valid frozen 10K cohort misses any semantic or aggregate-token gate.

hypotheses.mechanism: The larger native window retains enough evidence that terminal handles add little quality value.
hypotheses.prediction: Span-F1 gain is below 0.05 while aggregate treatment tokens may remain lower.
hypotheses.falsifier: H72 passes every frozen 10K transfer gate.

hypotheses.mechanism: Terminal handles help at 10K only after measured relevant-evidence displacement.
hypotheses.prediction: Effects separate by preregistrable displacement status and unconditional treatment fails the aggregate gate.
hypotheses.falsifier: Unconditional unchanged H72 passes without displacement conditioning.

hypotheses.mechanism: The 8K result does not transfer to 10K.
hypotheses.prediction: There is no qualifying quality gain within the token constraint.
hypotheses.falsifier: H72 passes every frozen 10K transfer gate and later fresh confirmation.
